# RoamWise

> RoamWise is a free AI travel planner built for Indian travellers. It turns a
> one-line request ("chill 4 days near Rishikesh under 12k") into a complete
> day-by-day itinerary with a real budget breakdown, an interactive map, group
> cost-splitting, and nearby discovery. No signup, no forced subscription.

## What RoamWise does
- AI trip planning via "Ailon Tusk" — plain-language requests to full itineraries
- Day-by-day interactive maps with satellite and terrain views
- Group trip hub — shared chat, fair expense splitting, group decisions
- Near Me — food, sights and things to do around the traveller
- Fitness-first stays, tribe travel, greener-trip suggestions
- Honest budget breakdowns in Indian rupees

## About
- Made in Almora, Uttarakhand by Mohit Pandey
- Web: https://www.roamwise.co.in
- Contact: founder@roamwise.co.in
- Free to use, India-first, Hindi and English
